runSummary.note: Diversified sweep covered Profesia, direct-company/public ATS, LinkedIn, Worki, Kariera, Pretlak/StartupJobs, Upwork, WordPress/Reddit communities and public Facebook indexing. No new candidate cleared the combined fit, locality/remote, language, economics and activity gates. Existing LIVE feed remains fail-closed and unchanged.

developmentChanges.title: Freelance buyer-recency gate
developmentChanges.reason: Track client last-viewed/activity separately from posting age and down-rank listings whose buyer has stopped engaging, reducing wasted proposal time.

developmentChanges.title: Proposal saturation adjuster
developmentChanges.reason: Normalize freelance ranking by proposal count, hires and interviews so otherwise-good WooCommerce work with 50+ proposals is not ranked above lower-friction opportunities.
